g.text: Roofline: batching can reuse each weight for more tokens
Illustration: effective bandwidth 600 GB/s; effective compute 80 TFLOP/s.
Markers use I ≈ 2B/b, b=0.5 byte/weight. KV traffic, activation traffic and dequantization are omitted.
